description: Sintel, hooded against the cold, is alone in a white snowy landscape with a staff, one hand raised to her face.
story: Alone in a frozen wasteland, Sintel pushes on through the snow.

description: A bald, bearded man attacks Sintel in the snow and the two grapple on the slope.
story: A stranger ambushes Sintel in the snow and they fight.

description: Sintel ends up lying on her back in the snow, a long pole across her body.
story: The fight leaves Sintel collapsed in the snow.

description: The title SINTEL appears over a snowy mountain, with a tiny figure walking at the bottom left.
story: SINTEL

description: In a firelit tent, an old man with a gray beard examines a staff that ends in a round metal cap.
story: In an old shaman's firelit tent, he studies the staff she carries.

description: A wide view over a vast city of crowded rooftops under a hazy sky.
story: Her story goes back to a city of rooftops.

description: Sintel finds a little winged creature on a cobbled rooftop, one of its wings bloodied.
story: On a rooftop, Sintel finds a baby dragon with a wounded wing.

description: Sintel holds out her hand to the injured little dragon, which looks at it.
story: Wary at first, the little dragon lets her reach out to it.

description: Sintel holds the little dragon in her lap with a hand on its head; blood is visible near its wing.
story: Sintel nurses the wounded baby dragon. She calls him Scales.

description: The little dragon dashes down a market alley, with people hurrying behind it.
story: Healed, Scales grows bold, darting through the busy market.

description: Sintel stands on a high rooftop at sunset watching a little dragon and a red bird fly across the sky.
story: At sunset, Sintel watches Scales learn to fly.

description: A much larger dragon with a long tail flies in near the little dragon above the rooftops.
story: Then a huge dragon swoops out of the sky toward Scales.

description: A pale, winged dragon with spread wings hovers over the rooftops.
story: The great dragon carries Scales off while Sintel reaches after him.

description: Alone among ruined rooftops, Sintel's expression hardens into a fierce, angry stare.
story: Furious, Sintel sets out to find that dragon and bring Scales home.

description: A tiny figure crosses an enormous sand desert.
story: Her search drags on across deserts, forests and mountains.

description: In a snowy landscape a figure in a hooded coat lies in the snow with a long staff beside her.
story: The journey wears her down: she collapses in the snow, where her story began.

description: Fingers rest on a round metal disc engraved with rings of symbols.
story: An engraved disc shows a lone tree, the landmark she has to find.

description: A lone tree stands on a dark hillside, matching the tree engraved on the disc a moment earlier.
story: She finds the lone tree from the disc. The dragon's lair is close.

description: Peering from the edge of a crystal-lit cave, Sintel sees an enormous dragon lying far away.
story: In a crystal cave, Sintel finally finds the dragon.

description: Sintel finds a young dragon curled asleep on a rock in the cave.
story: Deeper in the cave, she comes upon a young dragon asleep on a rock.

description: The enormous dragon blasts a jet of fire across the cave.
story: The great dragon turns on her with a blast of fire.

description: Sintel grips a dagger in both hands, her face tense.
story: Thrown down again and again, Sintel grips her blade.

description: The enormous dragon lies on the cave floor with red beneath it while Sintel stands a few paces away.
story: After a brutal fight, Sintel brings the dragon down.

description: Images from her long journey flash behind Sintel's red-tinted face: the fallen dragon is Scales, grown up.
story: Then the truth hits her: the dragon she struck down is Scales, grown up.

description: Sintel reaches out an open hand toward the fallen dragon.
story: She reaches out to him, just as she did when he was small.

description: Outside, Sintel sits alone on a cliff edge with her head bowed in a misty pink landscape.
story: Shattered, Sintel sits alone outside the cave.

description: In close view Sintel looks pained, tree roots behind her.
story: Grief and guilt overwhelm her.

description: A small tan winged creature lies on the ground near a tiny, distant Sintel, with white snowdrop flowers in the foreground.
story: Sintel leaves alone. A small winged creature lies near her path.
